description: The free-shipping rule (subtotal at least 5000 cents and tier not basic) is written twice with different names and a De Morgan-inverted form in quoteShipping and cartBanner: a semantic DRY violation, since a rule change must edit both

hard.note: The two copies use different variable names and one is negated with De Morgan, so they do not look alike

_calibration.note: Window modeled on ro-repeated-idiom with error severity for semantic duplication. Equivalence of the two expressions verified by execution on Node over tiers basic/plus and subtotals 4999/5000/5001.
